reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "istiod-remote chart replaced with `remote` profile: Installing istio clusters with a remote/external control plane via Helm has never been officially…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: The istiod-remote Helm chart is no longer available; remote control plane installations must migrate to using the istio chart with --set profile=remote

proposed.statement: The istiod-remote Helm chart has been removed and replaced with installing the istio chart using the remote profile via --set profile=remote.
